about.missionText: Our mission is to glorify God by proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ, being led by the Holy Spirit, making disciples, and demonstrating God's love through worship, word, and works.
about.pastorGreeting: Greetings in the precious name of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ!
about.pastorParagraph1: We're delighted that you've found your way to our website! This is where we share the latest happenings in our church family-from worship services to community gatherings and special events. No matter where you are on your faith journey-whether you've been with us for years, you're visiting for the first time, or you're simply exploring what it means to walk with God-you have a place here with us.
about.pastorParagraph2: Our hope is that IPC Hebron Neria serves as a source of hope, strength, and community for everyone who desires to grow closer to God and build meaningful relationships with others.
about.pastorParagraph3: Take some time to browse through our site. You'll find inspiring messages, thoughtful reflections, and plenty of ways to connect with others and be refreshed in your faith. We invite you to join us for worship and discover the ministries that speak to you. Our desire is to walk alongside you, offering support and friendship as you continue your journey with Christ.
about.pastorParagraph4: We're grateful you're here. May we grow together in faith as the Holy Spirit leads and guides us.

services.worshipText: Experience vibrant, Spirit-led worship with contemporary and traditional songs that honor God and invite His presence.
services.teachingText: Receive practical, Bible-based teaching that applies God's Word to everyday life and helps you grow in your faith.
services.fellowshipText: Connect with other believers in a warm, welcoming environment where everyone is valued and accepted.
services.prayerText: Join in corporate prayer and receive personal prayer ministry from our prayer team.

prayer.title: Prayer Request
prayer.subtitle: We're here to pray with you
prayer.prayerText: We believe in the power of prayer. Please share your prayer request with us, and our prayer team will intercede on your behalf. All requests are kept confidential and handled with care.
prayer.name: Name
prayer.received: Your prayer request has been received. Our prayer team will be lifting you up in prayer.
prayer.prayerMinistryText1: Our prayer team is committed to interceding for every request we receive. We believe that prayer changes things and that God hears and answers the prayers of His people.
prayer.prayerMinistryText2: Note: In production, prayer requests would be sent to a secure backend system and can be managed through an admin panel. You may want to integrate with email services or a database to store and manage requests.

triuneGod.title: The Triune God
triuneGod.content: We believe in one living and true God, eternally existing as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit—equal in power and glory. God created all things and continues to sustain and rule over all creation.

godFather.title: God the Father
godFather.content: We believe God the Father is eternal, all-knowing, ever-present, and all-powerful. He is holy and righteous, and His love was revealed through the sacrifice of His Son, Jesus Christ.

jesusChrist.title: Jesus Christ
jesusChrist.content: We believe in Jesus Christ, the Son of God—His virgin birth, sinless life, miracles, death for our sins, bodily resurrection, ascension to heaven, and His glorious return.

holyScriptures.title: The Holy Scriptures
holyScriptures.content: We believe the Bible, both Old and New Testaments, is the inspired Word of God and the final authority for faith and Christian living.

holySpirit.title: The Holy Spirit
holySpirit.content: We believe in the Holy Spirit, who convicts the world of sin, brings new life, sanctifies believers, and empowers them for godly living and ministry.

giftsBaptism.title: Gifts and Baptism of the Holy Spirit
giftsBaptism.content: We believe in the present work of the Holy Spirit and the operation of spiritual gifts. These gifts are to be used in love, unity, and order. We believe Jesus baptizes believers with the Holy Spirit for empowered service.

salvation.title: Salvation
salvation.content: We believe salvation is a gift of God, received by grace through faith in Jesus Christ—not by human works—and results in a transformed life.

sinNewBirth.title: Sin and New Birth
sinNewBirth.content: We believe all people are sinners and need salvation. Those who repent and confess Jesus Christ are born again by the Holy Spirit.

layingOnHands.title: Laying on of Hands
layingOnHands.content: We believe in the laying on of hands for the baptism of the Holy Spirit, ordination into ministry, and healing through the power of God.

church.title: The Church
church.content: We believe in one universal Church, the Body of Christ, made up of all believers, with Jesus Christ as its head.

ordinances.title: Church Ordinances
ordinances.content: We believe Jesus Christ established two ordinances for the Church: water baptism by immersion and the Lord's Supper.

sanctification.title: Sanctification
sanctification.content: We believe sanctification is the ongoing work of God that sets believers apart from sin and dedicates them to holy living.

lastThings.title: Last Things
lastThings.content: We believe in the rapture of the Church, the visible return of Jesus Christ, the resurrection of the dead, final judgment, eternal life for the righteous, and eternal separation for the wicked.

beginning.title: Our Journey Begins
beginning.paragraph1: The ministry in Neria began in **1989** under the leadership of **Pr. K. J. Raju** from IPC Mardhala, with **Pr. K. P. Babu** initiating the ministry work in Neria. Through faithful Gospel outreach during this early period, many people heard the Good News and came to faith in Jesus Christ, and the ministry took strong spiritual root in the region. During this initial phase, the work was also guided and supported by **Pr. Paul Varkey**, the Centre Pastor for the Mangalore District at that time, whose encouragement and spiritual oversight helped establish the church on a firm foundation of faith and doctrine.
beginning.paragraph2: As the ministry grew, the first baptism in Neria took place on **March 10, 1990**, marking a key spiritual milestone. During the early 1990s, the church purchased land and began gathering in a simple prayer shed, which became a place of worship, prayer, and spiritual growth where many lives were transformed.
beginning.paragraph3: In **1992**, by God’s grace, a permanent church building was constructed on the same land. This provided a stable place for worship, discipleship, and fellowship. Regular worship services, prayer meetings, and fellowship gatherings helped nurture unity and spiritual maturity.
beginning.paragraph4: Around **1997**, a parsonage was built for the pastors, strengthening pastoral care and ministry support. Through dedicated shepherding, prayer, and personal guidance, many families found hope and restoration. The church also reached out to the surrounding community with compassion and practical support, becoming a light in the area.
beginning.paragraph5: More than **20 members from this church have gone into mission work**, serving the Lord both **in India and abroad**. IPC Hebron Neria continues to stand strong spiritually in this land.
beginning.paragraph6: In **2024**, the church was blessed with a new building. While we thank God for physical growth, we rejoice even more in the spiritual growth—lives transformed, faith strengthened, families restored, and a community impacted by the love of Christ. IPC Hebron Neria continues to stand strong spiritually in this land, giving all glory, honour, and praise to Almighty God for His faithfulness and guidance throughout these years.
